mechanism.claim: At a fixed eight-hour boundary in an unusually volatile BTC block, an extreme final-two-hour change in the Binance perpetual-versus-spot log basis represents a temporary leverage-market dislocation. Trade the perpetual opposite the basis-change direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.long: basis_change<0: perpetual cheapened relative to spot
mechanism.short: basis_change>0: perpetual richened relative to spot
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCBR uses the first difference of directly aligned spot/perpetual price basis and trades convergence. SLVCR used same-direction partial price transmission under BVOL/DVOL expansion; premium-index candidates used Binance premium candles rather than cash-futures price basis. No prior control is promoted.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC cash-futures basis-dislocation clocks are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 480 exact aligned distinct minute rows per source in [decision-8h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.basis_start: log(perpetual open at decision-2h / spot open at decision-2h)
features.basis_end: log(perpetual close at decision-1m / spot close at decision-1m)
features.basis_shock_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(basis_change) among at most 270 valid fixed eight-hour blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.realized_variation: sum squared perpetual 1m close-to-close log returns within completed 8h block
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 270 valid fixed eight-hour blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent high-volatility cash-futures basis convergence mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, basis, or subset repair.
